title: Ultra weekend game jam starts this Friday!
author: ResenhaDoBar
selftext:
Our Ultra Weekend Game Jam starts this Friday May 22 at noon PST, runs 48 hours until May 24!

Also a great chance to test out some of the cool stuff in the studio: built in multiplayer, LLM-powered games, Phaser / Three.js / Godot support, image gen, MCP integration, agent skills, and Bali our AI producer handling code, assets, and systems as you go

We're also adding masterclasses and workshops throughout the weekend so you'll have support the whole way through

**Everyone gets full Ultra access + credit refreshes all weekend, top 10 get Ultra for a month and automatic entry to the JCL judges panel stage for a PS5**

Register here: [Jabali Ultra Weekend Game Jam · Luma](https://luma.com/dnmbjdos)
